libogg 1.3.5 (https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/ogg/libogg-1.3.5.tar.xz, BSD 3-Clause, see COPYING): bit packer
used by the aoTuV Vorbis encoder (../vorbis_aotuv). bitwise.c, framing.c, crctable.h, ogg.h, os_types.h unchanged;
include/ogg/config_types.h written here (stdint types) in place of the one configure would generate.
